---
title: "Every Left-Handed Fastball in 2025"
subtitle: "MLB Statcast velocity, pitch movement, spin rate, and ball/strike outcomes"
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)

fastballs <- read_parquet("lhp_fastballs_2025.parquet") |>
  drop_na(release_speed, pfx_x, pfx_z, release_spin_rate, type) |>
  mutate(
    horiz_in = pfx_x * 12,
    vert_in = pfx_z * 12,
    outcome = if_else(type == "B", "Ball", "Strike"),
    pitch_name = factor(pitch_name, levels = c("4-Seam Fastball", "Sinker", "Cutter"))
  )
```

This site tracks **`r scales::comma(nrow(fastballs))`** fastball-family pitches (**4-Seam Fastball**, **Sinker**, and **Cutter**) thrown by left-handed MLB pitchers during the 2025 season (source: MLB Statcast via Baseball Savant). Pitches put in play are counted as **Strikes**.

## Movement, Velocity, Spin Rate, and Outcome

Each point below is a single 2025 pitch from a left-handed pitcher (catcher's perspective: positive horizontal break runs arm-side toward a right-handed batter; negative cuts glove-side). Color shows **velocity (mph)**, point size reflects **spin rate (RPM)**, and panels split **Balls vs. Strikes** across each fastball type.

```{r}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 7
#| fig-dpi: 300

ggplot(
  fastballs,
  aes(
    x = horiz_in,
    y = vert_in,
    color = release_speed,
    size = release_spin_rate
  )
) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray60", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray60", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.25) +
  facet_grid(outcome ~ pitch_name) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "plasma", name = "Velocity (mph)") +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(0.1, 1.3), name = "Spin Rate (RPM)") +
  coord_equal(xlim = c(-25, 25), ylim = c(-25, 25)) +
  labs(
    title = "2025 MLB Left-Handed Fastballs: Movement, Velocity & Spin",
    subtitle = paste0(scales::comma(nrow(fastballs)), " pitches | Catcher's perspective (inches of break)"),
    x = "Horizontal Movement (inches)",
    y = "Induced Vertical Break (inches)",
    caption = "Source: MLB Statcast (Baseball Savant), 2025 Regular Season & Postseason"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
```

## Spin Rate vs. Velocity by Ball/Strike Outcome

To make spin rate and velocity easy to read directly for every pitch, this second chart plots **release velocity (mph)** against **spin rate (RPM)** across all three left-handed fastball types.

```{r}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 4.5
#| fig-dpi: 300

ggplot(
  fastballs,
  aes(x = release_speed, y = release_spin_rate, color = outcome)
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.15, size = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~pitch_name) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Strike" = "#1b7837", "Ball" = "#d95f02"),
    name = "Outcome"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(80, 100, by = 5)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(1200, 3200)) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1, size = 2.5))) +
  labs(
    title = "Spin Rate vs. Velocity on Every 2025 Left-Handed Fastball",
    x = "Velocity (mph)",
    y = "Spin Rate (RPM)",
    caption = "Source: MLB Statcast (Baseball Savant)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
```
